title: Household Relationship Months in the Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Hardship Offer
content:
**Customer relationship terms.** The hardship offer on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan) is adjusted for the household's other Ridgeline business: a customer whose entry or patio door contract was paid by cash, check or card and is closed and who also holds an active CareLine service plan adds the double relationship extension of 2 months; a customer with one of the two adds the relationship extension of 1 month; a customer with neither is not adjusted. The months are added to the lower of the per-request cap and the lifetime room; the offer is never more than the lifetime room and never below zero.

A CareLine service plan here means a CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year or Estate plan in active status; an On-Call Service Account is not a CareLine plan. The door contract is read from the customer's Entry & Patio Door Contracts records (payment method and status) and the plan from the customer's CareLine Service Plans records.

| Closed door contract paid by cash, check or card | Active CareLine plan | Months added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Yes | No | 1 |
| No | Yes | 1 |
| No | No | 0 |

## Points of judgement

- A door contract paid through Ridgeline financing, or one paid by cash, check or card that is not yet closed, is not a closed cash-paid door contract.
- An On-Call Service Account does not count, nor does a CareLine plan that is past due, cancelled or expired.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A customer with a closed Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door contract paid by card and an active CareLine Estate Plan, whose lower figure is 0 and whose lifetime room is 6: the offer becomes 2. Had the lifetime room been 1, the offer would be 1.
